fusions.name: Snap the Growth
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: a bite snaps it off for 8 damage, using it up and adding half its remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Mass Spawning
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of sharp spawn, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each of them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sunken Burrow
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Tide-Skipper

riders.text: you run over it faster than over ground
and blows miss you more often while you are on it
and your stamina comes back faster on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, from silver your dodge chance rises by 8% on it, and from gold your stamina recovers 25% faster on it.
